name: e-commerce-tester
description: Automated storefront health checks for Shopify and WooCommerce

scripts.install:browsers: pnpm exec playwright install chromium firefox webkit
scripts.lint: eslint tests/ config/ checks/ scripts/ web/ *.ts
scripts.lint:fix: eslint tests/ config/ checks/ scripts/ web/ *.ts --fix
scripts.test:acceptance:local: pnpm test:pacing && pnpm test:readiness && pnpm test:reporting && pnpm test:control:local && pnpm test:pages:local && pnpm test:vitals:local && pnpm test:visual:local && pnpm test:commerce:local && pnpm test:woocommerce:local && pnpm test:seo:local && pnpm test:journey:local && pnpm test:claims:local
scripts.check: pnpm run type-check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run check:toolchain
scripts.test:pacing: STORE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:45679 SITE_SLUG=pacing-local REQUEST_DELAY_MS=60 REQUEST_JITTER_MS=0 TEST_DELAY_MS=0 TEST_JITTER_MS=0 playwright test --config=checks/pacing.config.ts
scripts.test:readiness: STORE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:45981 REQUEST_DELAY_MS=0 REQUEST_JITTER_MS=0 TEST_DELAY_MS=0 TEST_JITTER_MS=0 playwright test --config=checks/readiness.config.ts
scripts.test:commerce:local: STORE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:45990 SITE_SLUG=commerce-local SITE_SETTINGS_JSON='{}' TEST_DELAY_MS=0 TEST_JITTER_MS=0 REQUEST_DELAY_MS=0 REQUEST_JITTER_MS=0 playwright test --config=checks/commerce.config.ts
scripts.test:pages:local: STORE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:45986 TEST_DELAY_MS=0 TEST_JITTER_MS=0 REQUEST_DELAY_MS=0 REQUEST_JITTER_MS=0 playwright test --config=checks/shared-pages.config.ts
